CRDS gossip table APIs for insert, expire, sample, and masked iteration.

# Purpose
This header declares the CRDS interface used by the gossip system to store, update, expire, and sample replicated cluster data. It defines the `fd_crds_t` container, entry and mask iterator types, alignment and magic constants, and a metrics structure for counts such as expired, evicted, and purged entries. The API covers creation, join, housekeeping with [`fd_crds_advance`](<#fd_crds_advance>), fast insert checks, full insertion, peer state updates, contact info lookup, and peer sampling. It also provides iterators for scanning CRDS entries and purged entries by hash mask, which supports gossip filter and pull request handling.
